BiblicalUsage: Malku is dominion, kingdom, the rule of God and of men, and Daniel is its book. Daniel 2:44 says the God of heaven shall set up a kingdom which shall never be destroyed, and Daniel 4:34 says His dominion is an everlasting dominion, and His kingdom is from generation to generation. Daniel 7:14 gives the Son of man a dominion that shall not pass away, and Daniel 7:27 says the kingdom and dominion shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word is Daniel's whole message: the kingdoms of men rise and fall, and the kingdom of God stands for ever. My position is that Daniel 7:27 is the end of the story, because the kingdom is not only God's, it is given to His people.
RelatedTopics: Kingdom of God; God's Sovereignty; Prophecy
